fichas.title: Office technology and changing workplace requirements
fichas.summary: Information and communication technologies are changing office work, reducing workstation space needs and enabling networked, mobile, and shared work arrangements. The text highlights workplace quality, flexibility, ecological considerations, and the effects of telecommuting and automation on office space and work practices.

fichas.title: Demand cycles and office typologies
fichas.summary: The page compares the changing demand for office types over time and presents room arrangements including small rooms, group offices, and divisible or linked layouts. It also depicts daily office use and assignment of staff to room types; the charts contain labels and percentages, some of which are not sufficiently clear to interpret as precise dimensions.

fichas.title: Room allocation and recommended office mix
fichas.summary: Usage diagrams describe staff assignment and room allocation, recommending a mix of individual and group rooms and permanent and flexible spaces. The page notes group offices for teams of 5–16 people and small rooms for one or two people, as well as the stated proportions for group and small-room office areas.
